Investigation first, then a targeted fix.

Evidence gathered on the live chat (chat.b3400a4d0daa16e7f8d444d34005092707636502): the canonical history is contiguous 1..10366 with no gaps; a faithful offline replay of the exact backend page contract plus the real useOlderChatEvents loop paged the entire chat in 65 clicks with 0 failures; a jsdom test of the real useChatRuntime.loadOlder showed a failed page followed by a retry does reach the port again and clears olderError. So the data, the page contract and the retry wiring were sound.

Fix in useHistoryScroll.ts: gate the scroll-driven and wheel-driven auto-loads and `request` itself on `!restoring.current`. Previously only onScroll checked it, so a wheel event during the ~3-frame position restore after a prepend could start a second load from a mid-restore position, and the two restores then competed and pinned the view near the top. ConversationTimeline.tsx now puts the failure text on the Retry button's tooltip, so a genuine backend error is diagnosable instead of silent.

Verified: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npx vitest run src/chat` 286 passed / 3 failed, and those same 3 fail with this change stashed (pre-existing Windows-dialect assertions expecting 'bash' plus a cache-unit mismatch), so no regression. Temporary reproduction harnesses were deleted.

Not verified: the running desktop app has not been rebuilt, so the fix is not live yet.

Chat chat.b3400a4d0daa16e7f8d444d34005092707636502 cannot load earlier activity: the timeline shows "Retry loading earlier activity" and clicking it changes nothing.

Investigation (evidence): the canonical history is contiguous (1..10366, no gaps); a faithful offline replay of the exact backend page contract plus the real `useOlderChatEvents` loop paged the whole chat in 65 clicks with 0 failures; a jsdom test of the real `useChatRuntime.loadOlder` proving a failed page followed by a retry reaches the port again and clears `olderError` passes. So the data, the page contract and the retry wiring are sound.

Defect: `desktop/src/chat/useHistoryScroll.ts` guards the scroll-driven auto-load with `!restoring.current` but the wheel-driven auto-load does not, and `request` itself does not either. After a successful prepend the layout effect restores the reading position over ~3 frames; a wheel event in that window starts a second load that captures a mid-restore scroll position, and the two restores then compete, leaving the view pinned near the top so upward scrolling never reaches the older rows. Fix: gate both the wheel handler and `request` on `!restoring.current`, matching `onScroll`. Also surface the error text on the Retry button so a real failure is diagnosable instead of silent.

data.title: Fix the older-activity auto-load cascade that pins the timeline at the top
